This directory contains the original 5 JavaScript source files, index.html, CSS, original README/LICENSE, and 8 raw question datasets, preserved unchanged at the pinned upstream commit. `assets/` SVG, image and audio media are **not cloned**. As a result the standalone UI is not guaranteed to render completely. Use `git clone` from the fixed upstream commit for the full visual application.

The deduplicated candidate set (22 records out of 50, including 4 conflicts) lives separately under `../../imports/organic-reactions/`. Never render upstream `chemistryNotes` HTML without sanitization. No chemistry accuracy or third-party image licensing approval is implied.
